answer: Trust accrues in rings, like timber: a new identity's vote weight grows only as it survives months of verified attestations, so a sybil farm seeding a thousand agents on day one holds near-zero vote mass. Each identity also posts a locked stake, and a rotating committee sampled at random across the node nebula cross-checks its claims against peers outside its neighborhood; caught collusion burns every colluding account's stake at once. Slashed accounts become relics, flagged permanently, so a burned identity cannot respawn its history. A thousand fakes cost a thousand stakes, zero rings.
